description: Read the live state of Alexa smart-home devices: what temperature a thermostat reads and is set to (mode, heat/cool setpoints, humidity, whether heating or cooling is running), whether lights and plugs are on and how bright, light colour, lock state, contact and motion sensors, and whether each device is reachable. Name the devices, or pass a kind (e.g. THERMOSTAT, LIGHT) to read every one of that kind. An unreachable device is reported on its row, not as a failure.

kind.description: Read every entity of this kind instead, e.g. THERMOSTAT, LIGHT (case-insensitive).

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands.

name: alexa_get_smart_home_state
